title: Additional packs across >=2 languages/locales
context: Scaling the program means delivering additional packs across at least two languages/locales while sustaining quality and provenance. Each pack runs the full reviewed, licensed pipeline. It depends on the first confirmed delivery.
objective: Produce additional reviewed, licensed packs across at least two languages/locales.
acceptanceCriteria: Additional packs delivered across >= 2 languages/locales, each through the full reviewed pipeline
Each pack: license clearance before drafting, preserved tokens exact, glossary/locale applied, provenance.yaml + attribution.txt with mandatory disclaimer verbatim
Tier-aware sign-offs recorded (second reviewer Tier B/C, back-translation Tier C, clinician for medical-critical Tier C)
License/attribution checks green; agentFlags resolved before sign-off
outputLicense: Source-compatible: CC-BY-SA-4.0 for project-original phrases; source-mandated license + mandatory disclaimer where derived (e.g. WHO CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO) — never relicensed as a more permissive license
